summary: Cavitation Technologies (CVAT) disclosed that on October 9, 2026 it signed a definitive tender offer agreement with BrightFlixx Finance (Luxembourg) S.A., replacing an August 14, 2026 agreement with European Guarantee Services. BrightFlixx intends to launch a cash tender offer for all CVAT shares for an aggregate $35 million, less outstanding liabilities, divided by shares outstanding at a Record Date set 45 business days after commencement. The offer, not yet commenced, would initially expire 60 business days after launch, with an extension to give at least 30 business days after the final price is announced. Closing conditions include a 90% minimum tender, CFIUS clearance, and concurrent consummation of a parallel Alchemy Beverages tender offer. Watch the final per-share price and CFIUS timing.
